requirements.title: SHIFTR argument restrictions
requirements.definition: I shall be integer; SHIFT shall be integer, nonnegative, and no greater than BIT_SIZE(I).

pending.SHIFTR-I-integer: Positive source control calls SHIFTR with integer I containing distinguished low and high bits; source-control mutation uses noninteger I and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.SHIFTR-SHIFT-integer: Positive source controls call SHIFTR with integer SHIFT values 0, 1, and BIT_SIZE(I); source-control mutation uses noninteger SHIFT and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.SHIFTR-SHIFT-nonnegative-and-at-most-bit: Positive source controls call SHIFTR with SHIFT=0, SHIFT=1, and SHIFT=BIT_SIZE(I); source-control mutations use -1 and BIT_SIZE(I)+1 and claim no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: SHIFTR result value follows ISHFT(I,-SHIFT)
requirements.definition: The value of SHIFTR(I,SHIFT) is ISHFT(I,-SHIFT).

pending.SHIFTR-equals-ISHFT-formula: Use I with bits 1 and 4 set, SHIFT=2, and assert selected BTEST results equal ISHFT(I,-SHIFT); include SHIFT=BIT_SIZE(I) and assert POPCNT(SHIFTR(I,BIT_SIZE(I))) equals POPCNT(ISHFT(I,-BIT_SIZE(I))) in bit context; mutate the sign of the ISHFT comparison shift.
pending.SHIFTR-zero-shift-preserves-bits: Use I with bits 0, 3, and BIT_SIZE(I)-2 set, SHIFT=0, and assert selected BTEST results plus POPCNT match I exactly; companion SHIFT=1 avoids a vacuous unchanged check.
pending.SHIFTR-right-shift-bits: Use a bit pattern with one bit shifted out and one retained, assert only BTEST and POPCNT observations in bit context; add nonzero I with bits BIT_SIZE(I)-2 and BIT_SIZE(I)-4 set, SHIFT=BIT_SIZE(I), and assert POPCNT(SHIFTR(I,BIT_SIZE(I)))==0, then mutate SHIFT to 0.
